description.zh: 加速域名。若参数为空，则返回所有加速域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name to query. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns information about all accelerated domain names.
The ID of the region where the WAF instance is deployed. You can set this to `cn-hangzhou` (the default). At present, you can only set this to `cn-hangzhou`.

description.zh: 资源组。若参数为空，代表默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries the default resource group.

descriptions.zh:
该API适用于旧版WAF防护。
> 单用户调用频率：150次/秒。
descriptions.en:
This API applies to the legacy WAF protection.

> Rate limit: 150 requests/second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-waf-domain --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --resource-group-id / --region cn-hangzhou
